name: Fianna Mellowa
source:
The emperor's only daughter. Because she can't sense people's ill will, she is friendly to everyone. Since she is a princess, her way of thinking is considerably different than normal people's.

[Based on the [url=http://www.littlewitch.jp/home/special/LWRQ/pg115.html]official site[/url]]
